premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A valuable ore deposit lies beneath a place important to several families, though not all villagers share its significance.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The village searches elsewhere and debates the cost.

b.name: Answer B

c.text: Some accept a new site while others mourn the change.
